summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of attendance change approvals (/attendance-approvals). All 15 backend pytest tests pass covering list filters, pagination, counts, search by name/student_number, sort, new_status filter, filter-options, stats, Excel export (xlsx magic bytes verified), RBAC (teacher 403, Salim dean-scoped). Frontend: all required data-testids present and wired (approval-stats + 4 stat cards + faculty chips, 5 status tabs with count badges, filter bar with all 9 selects, search w/ debounce + URL sync, chips add/remove, approval-filters-reset appears when filters active, approval-filters-toggle, date shortcuts set lecture range + chip-lecture_range, view-list/view-grouped (75 group elements rendered), lecture-group-approve/reject buttons, pagination w/ page-2 + next on status=all, empty-state + empty-reset-btn, reject modal (reject-notes-input/confirm/cancel), batch-approve/batch-reject buttons on row-select, select-all-btn, request-row-<id>, faculty chip click filters URL correctly). RTL layout renders cleanly.

issues: Three initial 403 responses on page load (one axios Promise.all failure) even when logged in as admin. The approvals page itself works, so these likely come from an unrelated badge/widget that calls another endpoint lacking an admin bypass. Please locate the failing request (dev tools Network tab) and either hide for admin or grant correct permission. Not blocking.

Numerous React Native Web warnings: 'shadow* deprecated → use boxShadow', 'props.pointerEvents deprecated', 'TouchableMixin deprecated', 'Unknown event handler onStartShouldSetResponder/...', 'Unexpected text node: a text node cannot be a child of a <View>', and 'Require cycle: EmployeeFormModal <-> HrSelect'. Pre-existing but worth cleaning up.

Chip for level filter displays as 'المستوى: 99p' when level=99 (visual artefact — appears to concatenate a sort suffix 'p'). Minor cosmetic; worth checking chip label logic in ApprovalFilterBar for level.

action_items: Investigate 3 initial 403 console errors on /attendance-approvals as admin (likely unrelated widget).
Verify chip label for level filter does not append spurious character (saw 'المستوى: 99p').
critical_code_review_comments: attendance_approval.py is ~850 lines — close to the 700-line guideline threshold; consider splitting (helpers, list/filter-options/stats, export, mutations).
_build_filter_query mutates faculty_id only if not already in scope — correct, dean scope preserved. Good.
requested_at date-range parses with datetime.fromisoformat on 'YYYY-MM-DD' and sets tzinfo — fine.
Count aggregation uses the same base filter (excluding status) — matches spec.
Export uses StreamingResponse + proper RTL xlsx, headers at row 4 — matches spec.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of specified testids present and interactive
